text:
Vincent Trocheck arrived in Utah from the Rangers on July 1, and lately the Mammoth have been leaning on him hard. His ice time over the last ten games is up four and a half minutes a night, to almost 22, and he has a six-game point streak going. He is 33, still throws his body around (68 hits in 27 games), and he plays against the other team's best: Evolving-Hockey put his competition in the 99th percentile last season.

The numbers say he is due for a few more goals. Six on 8.5 expected, his own chances at 0.99 expected goals per 60 minutes, well above the 0.68 he managed in his last year in New York. Utah takes 59% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, and his line has run slightly lucky around him, which balances out.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking said 53% of his shots came off the rush last season. The first few seconds after a turnover are still where we'd watch him.
